title: Podcast & Pensées 129 | The ‘Revolution’ Will Be Telegrammed.
text:
Stated Claim / Post Context:
Podcast & Pensées 129 | The ‘Revolution’ Will Be Telegrammed.

Burning Cows, Mental Asylum, Disinfolklore Propagation Apparatus (Telegram) Bans: Using Disinfolklore to Predict the Future.

Actual Article Body:
⚡️The ‘Revolution’ will be Telegrammed.

That this is the true purpose of shutting it down.

The ‘revolution’ will be branded ‘The Telegram Revolution’. To mimic the true belief of Russian security state operatives that Ukraine’s Colour Revolution of Dignity was a CIA plot.

The Disinfolklore has already been written. Durov will be made minister for communications or defence. Ruschia’s attempt to copy Ukraine.

A new Russia will be archetyped. Through Disinfolklore. Cue breathless articles in western media about how a New Order has been established. The millions of Russians who participated in the murder of over a million people in Ukraine are as innocent as the people they murdered. Yaddah, yaddah.

KGB with its stash of Epstein Kompromat affecting MANY countries but mainly Israel and America. KGB will remain in charge, of Russia, of America, of Israel. Through their Kompromatted cut-outs like Kushner (pater and son masking his succession of Epstein with his ‘investment’ fund protection racket that doesn’t provide any protection. Just ask Qatar, by the way Don needs a second gold 747 which Qatar will provide. That’s how protection rackets work.), Witkoff, Bessent, Donald,…

Anyone who tolerated honey-trapping Epstein Kompromised leadership today.

Same families of Chekists/KGB been in charge of Ruschia for 200 years. Same genes. Same memes. Communism, Empire, Russkiy Mir: old wine, new bottles.

Kompromised leaders like Donald and his entire cabinet will campaign to let Ruschia back in to the community of nations. Its people have suffered enough. Yaddah. Yaddah. Paul Manafort has already made a presentation on the campaign to brainwash us.

Look at its new generation of iPhone wielding Telegram using non-complicit population!

It was all Stalin, I mean, Putler’s doing!

The war wasn’t our fault!

We didn’t mean to murder all those Ukrainians!

We was forced to!

By the way, we’re keeping Crimea (note to file: No. You’re. Not)…

I could write the script myself.

How?

Just as I used the Disinfolklore Analytical Method to telegraph the upcoming Chef Saucerer Prighozin’s coup five weeks in advance, here once again I’m using deep knowledge of the mythology structures inside Russian Disinfolklore to predict regime change in Ruschia.

How can Sorcerer Putin survive, if he passes the reins to the Chef Charioteer he trained and empowered?

https://www.disinfolklore.eu/Disinfolklore/Mechanisms/Archetypes/Prigozhin-Coup-Forecast/

Same troll every new leader for the past 200 years. We can already see its structure in the Disinfolklore about burning peasants cows alive in Siberia, ‘dissidents’ in mental hones for criticising the czar, excuses for ‘fake’ revolution.

Characters like ‘shutting down Disinfolklore-spreading/propagating Telegram’ then new characters’ liberal credentials established by ‘unshutting Telegram down.’ a new Russia… Yaddah, Yaddah… Regorms. Reformer.

Russia is a One Trick Pony, I mean, Donkey.

Heaps of people (though hopefully not our leaders) will fall for the troll.

Russia’s still thinking it can then continue its murder, genocide and war, while Donald says Ruschia has suffered enough.

This last gasp plan will fail.

Even Donald and America does not have the power/Mana/resources to save Ruschia.

Then, there’s Ukraine which I am quite certain will not relent until this dragon is utterly smited. So that Ukrainians’ children’s children do not have to face this again.
